name: AI Chat
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: An AI helper for chat. Viewers ask it questions with !ask, it can answer when someone @mentions the bot, and workflows can ask it to write text such as a raid welcome. Uses the streamer's own Anthropic or OpenAI API key.

settings.label: AI service
settings.description: Type anthropic to use Claude, or openai to use ChatGPT.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: Your API key from the AI service you picked.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Leave blank for the default: claude-sonnet-5-5 for Anthropic, gpt-4.1-mini for OpenAI.

settings.label: Personality
settings.description: Tell the AI who it is and how to talk, such as a pirate, a hype squad, or a calm helper.
settings.defaultValue: You are a friendly, upbeat helper in a live stream's chat. Keep it kind, fun and family friendly.

settings.label: Longest reply (characters)
settings.description: Replies are cut to this length. Twitch chat allows up to 500.

settings.label: Wait between questions (seconds)
settings.description: How long each viewer waits before the AI answers them again. 0 turns this off.

settings.label: Answer @mentions
settings.description: When on, the AI also answers chat messages that @mention the bot's name below.

settings.label: Bot name
settings.description: The chat name viewers @mention to talk to the AI, without the @.

actions.name: Ask AI
actions.description: Ask the AI to write something, such as a welcome for a raider or a hype line for a new sub. The reply is handed to later steps, so a Send chat message step can post it. The step fails, with the reason, when the AI service can't be reached or the API key is wrong.

schema.label: What to ask
schema.placeholder: Write a one-line hype welcome for a raider named ${trigger.data.fromBroadcasterUserName}
schema.description: What the AI should write or answer. You can include details from the trigger.

fields.description: The AI's reply on one line, cut to the module's longest-reply setting.

actions.name: Answer chat question with AI
actions.description: Runs from a chat command: answers the text after the command in chat, tagging the viewer. Each viewer waits out the module's cooldown between questions.

fields.description: True when an answer was posted in chat.
The answer posted in chat. Absent when nothing was posted.

actions.name: Answer chat mention with AI
actions.description: Runs on a chat message: when the message @mentions the bot and Answer @mentions is on, answers it in chat. Otherwise does nothing.

fields.description: True when an answer was posted in chat.
The answer posted in chat. Absent when nothing was posted.
